macros.name: cyprfamily
macros.doc: Selects the Cypriot font family in the T1 encoding if this is the document’s default encoding, otherwise make it the OT1 encoding.

macros.name: textcypr
macros.doc: The command \textcypr{⟨text⟩} typesets ⟨text⟩ in the Cypriot font.

macros.name: translitcypr
macros.doc: The command \translitcypr{⟨char-commands⟩}, where ⟨char-commands⟩ are the Cypriot character commands, will typeset a transliteration of the signs.

macros.name: translitcyprfont
macros.doc: The transliterated Cypriot is typeset with the font declarations specified by \translitcyprfont, which defaults to \itshape thus printing the transliteration in an italic font.
